dimensions.label: Paris Commune
dimensions.description: The Paris Commune was a revolutionary government that ruled Paris from March 18 to May 28, 1871. It was established after the Franco-Prussian War and is often depicted in historical illustrations as a period of intense social upheaval and violence, including street fighting and mob actions. The bottom image from 'Le Petit Journal Illustré' is a well-known depiction of the Commune's violence, specifically the suppression of the uprising by French government forces.
